name: U-ZrH (TRIGA, H/Zr 1.6), k = 18 W/m/K
label: sourced
description: Fuel-moderator of TRIGA Mark III elements: 8.5 wt% U, 20% enriched, delta-phase ZrH1.6. Conductivity stated as nearly independent of temperature.
citation: UT-Austin SAR Table 4.1: thermal conductivity 0.18 W/cm/K. K-State SAR Table 13.3 and Table 4.6: 18 W/m/K, all temperatures; K-State attributes General Atomics and Simnad (1980) and says there is little temperature dependence over the range of interest. Sources: University of Texas at Austin TRIGA II Research Reactor Safety Analysis Report, Chapter 4, 8/2023 (research/VIRTUAL REACTOR/University of Texas-Austin TRIGA Research Reactor Safety Analysis Report - Redacted Version.pdf); Kansas State University TRIGA Mark II Safety Analysis Report, Dec 2004 (research/VIRTUAL REACTOR/Kansas State University, Safety Analysis Report Dated 12_21_2004_.pdf).

thermal.conductivity.source: K-State SAR 2004 Table 13.3 (18 W/m/K, all temperatures); UT-Austin SAR 2023 Table 4.1 (0.18 W/cm/K)

label: sourced
description: Straight line through the SAR's end points (14.9 W/m/K at 300 K, 19.8 at 600 K); it gives 16.53 at 400 K against the tabulated 16.6. Valid only over 300 to 600 K.
citation: Fit by this project to K-State SAR Table 13.3 (14.9 W/m/K at 300 K, 16.6 at 400 K, 19.8 at 600 K; the SAR cites Incropera and DeWitt 1990 and the Metals Handbook 1961). The fit is ours; the three points are the SAR's. Source: Kansas State University TRIGA Mark II Safety Analysis Report, Dec 2004 (research/VIRTUAL REACTOR/Kansas State University, Safety Analysis Report Dated 12_21_2004_.pdf).
